capabilities: Track and list files by creation or modification date in a sidebar
Filter the list by file type and search by filename
Pin files to the top of the list
Rename files with a SHA-256 hash to resolve name collisions
Hover over entries to preview images and PDFs
extras: Settings allow toggling individual feature modules (core tracking, filter/sort, hover preview, rename action) on or off.
intentEvidence: The original idea and core architecture draw heavily from recent-files-obsidian by tgrosinger
motivation: The author built it to fill a specific gap: recent-files-obsidian tracks recently opened or edited files, while this plugin focuses on recently added files that just landed in the vault.
problem: Obsidian shows recently opened or edited files, not files that were just imported or created in bulk, so newly dropped-in images, PDFs and notes are hard to locate and process.

relations.evidence: The original idea and core architecture draw heavily from recent-files-obsidian by tgrosinger

summary: Sidebar panel that lists files by when they were added or modified, with type filters, search, pinning, hash renames, and hover previews.
